probes.name: C3-blind
probes.subject: tools/check_ac_consistency.py
probes.expect_claim: test_a_ticked_ac_whose_artifact_is_in_no_battery_is_found|[(g.ac, "test_uncovered.py" in g.reason) for g in gaps] == [(1, True)]|#0
probes.note: 🔴 The check stops seeing the gap at all — the s278 defect, reintroduced.

probes.name: C3-overfire
probes.subject: tools/check_ac_consistency.py
probes.note: 🔴 Drops the artifact-side basename normalisation, so a full-path artifact stops matching a basename source and a CORRECT tree is accused. This is the false positive measured on PLAN-0120 before the fix.

probes.name: C3-bindblind
probes.subject: tools/check_ac_consistency.py
probes.expect_claim: test_a_plan_that_binds_ticks_to_probes_but_names_no_battery_is_found|len(gaps) == 1 and gaps[0].ac is None and "names no batteries" in gaps[0].reason|#0
probes.note: 🔴 Reopens the silent-exemption door: omit the header line and every tick goes unchecked.
probes.why: re-anchored s315: the comparison gained `.lower()` when Check 3 was found sleeping through a PLAN that wrote the binding sentence capitalised. The mutation is unchanged; only the text locating it moved.

probes.name: C3-unscoped
probes.subject: tools/check_ac_consistency.py
probes.note: 🔴 The measured false positive: unscoped, this fired on PLAN-0121 at 0 of 8 ticked. C3-bindblind stays green under it, so the two claims are separately witnessed.
probes.why: re-anchored s315: the comparison gained `.lower()` when Check 3 was found sleeping through a PLAN that wrote the binding sentence capitalised. The mutation is unchanged; only the text locating it moved.

probes.name: C3-vacuous
probes.subject: tools/check_ac_consistency.py
probes.expect_claim: test_a_batteries_glob_matching_nothing_is_an_error_not_a_skip|len(gaps) == 1 and gaps[0].ac is None and "matches no files" in gaps[0].reason|#0
probes.note: 🔴 THE vacuity door: a glob matching nothing would pass silently, and the guard becomes the thing it exists to prevent.

probes.name: C3-noart
probes.subject: tools/check_ac_consistency.py
probes.old:
if seg is None:
            continue  # an AC with no test artifact (a command-run AC) is not a gap
probes.note: 🔴 Accuses an AC that legitimately names no test module — PLAN-0120's AC-10 runs commands.

probes.name: C3-reviewblind
probes.subject: tools/check_ac_consistency.py
probes.why: remove the review-closed exemption outright: a docs AC's uncovered artifact is reported again and the exemption's own test reddens.

probes.name: C3-reviewwide
probes.subject: tools/check_ac_consistency.py
probes.expect_claim: test_an_ac_claiming_both_a_probe_and_a_review_is_held_to_the_probe|[(g.ac, "test_uncovered.py" in g.reason) for g in gaps] == [(1, True)]|#0
probes.why: drop the probe-wins precedence: an AC claiming BOTH a probe and a review is exempted, so the assertion that it is still held to the probe reddens.

probes.name: C3-reviewnarrow
probes.subject: tools/check_ac_consistency.py
probes.why: narrow the matcher to `review` only — the matcher a reader would write from PLAN-0128's two examples alone. The counted-variety case (PLAN-0125's AC-14 closes on a READ) stops being exempt and its assertion reddens. Scoped to the [read] case: unscoped, the narrowing reddens both parametrised cases and the driver refuses the credit (measured — MISFIRE).

exemptions.test_a_bare_filename_artifact_matches_a_: 🟢 Co-falsified with C3-overfire in the only expressible direction. Bare-filename and full-path artifacts are normalised by the SAME basename split; mutating the source side reddens this and the covered-is-clean claim together, and mutating the artifact side reddens only the latter. Recorded rather than faked (CLAUDE.md §8). C3-overfire witnesses the shared normalisation.
exemptions.test_the_live_repo_has_no_battery_gaps|g: 🟢 The live-tree instance of the covered-is-clean claim: any mutation that manufactures a false gap on the real repo also manufactures one on the tmp tree, so C3-overfire reddens both and no mutation separates them. Its value is as a standing assertion that the guard agrees with the tree it ships in.
exemptions.test_a_probe_closed_ac_with_an_uncovered: OVER-DETERMINED, and this is measured rather than argued. For a probe-closed AC to become exempt TWO independent conditions must both flip: _CLOSES_REVIEW must match its text (it does not - the clause says `witnessed probe`, naming none of review/read/ruling) AND _CLOSES_PROBE must not match (it does). A single-subject mutation breaks at most one, so the assertion stays green: probe C3-reviewprobeword widened _CLOSES_REVIEW to swallow `probe` and came back GREEN, and it was DELETED rather than re-aimed. The only mutation that reddens it - exempting every AC unconditionally - reddens five tests at once, which the driver refuses to credit by design. What the assertion still buys is real and is witnessed next door: C3-reviewwide removes the `not _CLOSES_PROBE` half alone and reddens the sibling assertion, proving that half is live.
